```yaml
name: Prompt Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  prompt-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run test task
        run: npm run test:sentry
```
